rationale: High-conversion student EdTech demands a premium, reliable, yet futuristic feel to combat the anxiety of AI disruption. We respect the existing indigo→purple→cyan 'grad-primary' brand gradient but elevate it by placing it over a deep obsidian/indigo black background. This creates a striking, modern 'SaaS dark mode' that converts highly with Gen-Z users coming from mobile (IG Reels).

colors.primary_gradient_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-400 via-purple-400 to-cyan-300

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-tight

spacing_and_layout.mobile_first_rules: Stack elements on mobile. Use max-w-full. Ensure touch targets are at least 48px tall.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.tracing_beam_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0F] border border-white/5 group hover:border-purple-500/30 transition-colors duration-500
surfaces_and_micro_themes.report_blur_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-[#05050A]/60 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col items-center justify-center z-10

sections.name: 0. Header / Navigation
sections.instructions: Floating Crystal Glass sticky header. z-50. bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5. Must contain Logo (MapMyCareer) and primary CTA 'Get Blueprint'. Mobile must have hamburger or simply hide non-essential links to keep CTA visible.

sections.name: 1. Hero Section
sections.instructions: First 3s impact. Center aligned. H1: 'Most Students Will Spend 4 Years Preparing For A Career That AI May Change.' Highlight 'AI May Change' using primary_gradient_text. Below H1: Subheadline. Then, the lead magnet: An inline form with a select/input for 'Enter Your Degree' attached directly to the 'Generate My Free Career Blueprint ->' CTA button. Trust microcopy below the input with checkmarks. Background: Deep obsidian with subtle purple/cyan ambient glows (blur-[120px]).

sections.name: 2. Problem / Pain Section
sections.instructions: Highlight the mismatch between college syllabi and AI speed. Use 'Control Room' grid (dense, sharp). Left side: bold statement 'The Job Market Is Changing Faster Than College Syllabi'. Right side: 2-3 stat cards with subtle red/orange accents indicating 'Risk' or 'Outdated Curriculum'.

sections.name: 3. Report Preview (The Tease)
sections.instructions: A premium dashboard mockup built with UI code (not an image). Show partial elements: AI Automation Risk Score, Salary Potential, Skill Gap. Apply a heavy glassmorphic blur overlay covering the bottom half. Overlay text: 'Unlock Full Personalized Results' with a CTA button.

sections.name: 4. What You Get (Features)
sections.instructions: 6 premium feature cards in a Bento Grid format (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Use 'tracing_beam_card' style. Features: AI Automation Risk, Salary Growth, Career Match, Skill Gap, Learning Roadmap, Future Trends. Icons must be lucide-react with cyan or purple accents.

sections.name: 5. Social Proof
sections.instructions: Avoid stock photos. Use colored circles with initials (e.g., 'A', 'S') for Indian student avatars. Include name, degree/stream, city, and 5-star rating (lucide-react Star). Add a small green 'Verified Student' check badge.

sections.name: 6. College-Specific Segments
sections.instructions: Horizontal scroll or flex-wrap row of tags/small cards for B.Tech, BCA, B.Com, MBA Aspirants, Fresh Graduates. Active state uses the primary gradient border. When clicked (or just as static cards), shows relevant benefits.

sections.name: 7. Pricing & Urgency
sections.instructions: Strikethrough regular price (₹499). Highlight Student Launch Price (₹199). Use a bold, high-contrast card. Include ethical urgency banner: 'Launch Price Available For A Limited Time'. CTA: 'Get My Career Blueprint Now ->'. List inclusions with green checkmarks.

sections.name: 8. Trust & Payment Security
sections.instructions: Below pricing. Text: '100% Secure Payments Powered By Razorpay', 'Zero Hidden Charges'. Use simple pill badges for payment methods: UPI, GPay, Paytm, Visa, Mastercard (use text or simple SVG shapes/react-icons).

sections.name: 9. FAQ
sections.instructions: Accordion style (use shadcn/ui or simple details/summary). Clean borders, text-white for question, text-slate-400 for answers.

sections.name: 10. Lead Capture Funnel Form
sections.instructions: Triggered by CTAs or sticky mobile bar. Max 3 fields: Name, WhatsApp Number, Degree/Major. Minimal friction. High contrast active states on inputs. Submit feeds into the existing questionnaire funnel.

sections.name: 11. Floating WhatsApp Button
sections.instructions: Persistent bottom-right button. Green glow. 'Need Help? Chat With Us' tooltip. Z-index 50. Use lucide-react MessageCircle or standard WhatsApp green.

PrimaryCTA.classes: inline-flex items-center justify-center w-full sm:w-auto h-14 px-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-cyan-400 text-white font-bold text-lg hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(168,85,247,0.5)] transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-1 active:translate-y-0

SecondaryCTA.classes: inline-flex items-center justify-center h-12 px-6 rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white font-semibold hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors border border-white/20

Input.classes: h-14 w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full px-6 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 focus:border-transparent placeholder:text-slate-500

Select.classes: h-14 w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-full px-6 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 appearance-none

media_and_icons.icons_library: lucide-react (mandatory for core UI). install react-icons if required for payment logos.
media_and_icons.images: No stock photos. Use UI code for mockups and CSS for avatars. Hero should rely on typography, layout, and deep ambient gradient glows.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All cards should have subtle hover:-translate-y-1 and border color shift. Buttons must have shadow glows.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Use Framer Motion for entrance animations. Staggered fade-up for features and testimonials.

testing_attributes.instructions: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements. E.g., data-testid='hero-degree-input', data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='whatsapp-fab'.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-conversion landing page. 95% traffic is mobile. Ensure mobile stack is perfect (padding, thumb-friendly buttons).
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for complex overlapping marketing layouts rather than Shadcn cards which are too rigid.
Use Framer Motion to animate the hero text and entrance of the bento grid cards.
Implement the 'Report Preview' section purely with HTML/CSS. Build a fake UI dashboard with stats and place an absolute positioned blur overlay on top of it.
For avatars, use a simple rounded div with a background color and the student's initials inside, do NOT use placeholder images.
Ensure 'grad-primary' brand identity is felt throughout the page via glowing accents, text gradients, and CTA backgrounds.
Add a sticky mobile CTA at the bottom of the screen (on mobile only) once the user scrolls past the hero.
